name: Bishop
ability: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.
setup: Traveller: joins with an alignment chosen by the Storyteller; does not change the base character counts.
interaction: Each dawn the Bishop is marked NOMINATE EVIL (if good) or NOMINATE GOOD (if evil). Players cannot nominate for execution; the Storyteller nominates, removes the reminder once an opposing player is nominated, and cannot end nominations while it remains.
drunk_or_poisoned: Players nominate normally while the Bishop is drunk or poisoned.

rulings.text: Exiles are not nominations: anyone may call for a Traveller's exile.
The Storyteller should nominate all alive players on the final day.
If the Bishop is exiled, nominations proceed normally afterward.

test_scenarios.name: player cannot nominate
test_scenarios.setup: Alice good Bishop, Bob Imp, Carol Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Carol tries to nominate Bob.

test_scenarios.name: must nominate evil
test_scenarios.setup: Alice good Bishop, Bob Imp, Carol Chef, Dave Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: the Storyteller nominates Carol and tries to end nominations.
test_scenarios.expected: Not allowed while NOMINATE EVIL remains; Bob or Dave must be nominated.

test_scenarios.name: evil Bishop
test_scenarios.setup: Alice evil Bishop, Bob Imp, Carol Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: NOMINATE GOOD is removed; nominations may close.

test_scenarios.name: exile still allowed
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Bob calls for Alice's exile; a majority agrees.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice is exiled; players then nominate normally.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Bishop
test_scenarios.setup: Alice good Bishop poisoned by Dave Poisoner, Carol Chef.
